'''Víctor Claver Arocas''' (born 30 August 1988) is a Spanish former professional [[basketball]] player who last served as the [[captain (sports)|team captain]] for [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]].

==Professional career==

===Valencia (2006–2012)===
Claver began his playing career with the youth teams of his school, Sagrado Corazón HH. Maristas de Valencia, in Spain. He made his professional debut with [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] during the 2006–07 season. He played in [[European professional club basketball pyramid|Europe's second-tier level]] competition, the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]], for the first time during the 2007–08 season, and won it in the 2009–10 season.

He also played in the European top-tier level, [[EuroLeague]], during the 2010–11 season, and averaged 10.9 points and 4.9 rebounds, over 14 games.

===Portland Trail Blazers (2012–2015)===
Claver was drafted 22nd overall by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in the [[2009 NBA draft]]. On 12 July 2012, Claver signed a three-year deal with the Trail Blazers.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/PressReleaseDisplay/tabid/297/ItemID/3170/Default.aspx |title=Trail Blazers Sign Spanish International Victor Claver |work=iamatrailblazersfan.com |date=12 July 2012 |access-date=15 July 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120715050622/http://www.iamatrailblazersfan.com/PressReleaseDisplay/tabid/297/ItemID/3170/Default.aspx |archive-date=15 July 2012 |url-status=usurped |df=dmy-all}}</ref> He was assigned to the [[NBA G League|NBA D-League]]'s [[Idaho Stampede]] on 7 December 2012, and recalled on 9 December 2012.<ref name=dleague>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2012_13.html |title=2012–13 NBA Assignments |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=5 September 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140327190108/http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2012_13.html |archive-date=27 March 2014 |url-status=dead |df=dmy-all}}</ref> The following day, he made his first NBA start, scoring 4 points in 25 minutes with 5 rebounds and 2 assists.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/games/20121210/TORPOR/gameinfo.html |title=Box Score, Portland vs. Toronto, Monday, December 10, 2012 |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |date=10 December 2012 |work=nba.com |access-date=12 December 2012}}</ref> Claver was reassigned to the Idaho Stampede on 14 December 2012, and recalled on 16 December 2012.<ref name=dleague/>  He played 80 games for the Trail Blazers over the next three years.

On 19 February 2015, Claver was traded, along with [[Will Barton]], [[Thomas Robinson (basketball)|Thomas Robinson]] and a lottery-protected 2016 first-round pick, to the [[Denver Nuggets]] in exchange for [[Arron Afflalo]] and [[Alonzo Gee]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Nuggets Acquire Barton, Claver, Robinson and Protected First Round Pick From Portland |url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-acquire-barton-claver-robinson-and-protected-first-round-pick-portland |access-date=23 February 2015 |work=NBA.com |date=19 February 2015}}</ref> Three days later, he was waived by the Nuggets before playing in a game for them.<ref>{{cite news |title=Nuggets Waive Claver and Robinson |url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-waive-claver-and-robinson |access-date=22 February 2015 |work=NBA.com |date=22 February 2015}}</ref>

===Khimki Moscow (2015)===
On 1 March 2015, Claver signed with [[BC Khimki]] of Russia for the rest of the season.<ref>{{cite news |title=BC Khimki signed with Victor Claver |url=http://en.bckhimki.ru/news/clubnews/2015/march/1042/ |access-date=1 March 2015 |work=bckhimki.ru |date=1 March 2015}}</ref> On 17 July 2015 Claver and Khimki parted ways.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/169183/khimki-parted-ways-with-victor-claver.html Khimki parted ways with Victor Claver]</ref>

===Attempt to return to Spain===
In August 2015, he had a deal with [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]],<ref name="Tanteo">{{cite web |url=http://www.eurohoops.net/featured/119324/claver-in-loko-randle-back-in-maccabi |title=Claver in Loko, Randle back in Maccabi |publisher=eurohoops.net |date=20 August 2015 |access-date=20 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115339 |title=El Laboral Kutxa Baskonia presenta oferta por Víctor Claver |publisher=acb.com |language=es |date=20 August 2015 |access-date=20 July 2016 |archive-date=3 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403015135/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115339 |url-status=dead }}</ref> but [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] using the [[right of first refusal]], matched the offer, and kept his rights in Spain.<ref name="Tanteo"/><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115420 |title=Valencia Basket iguala la oferta del Laboral Kutxa Baskonia por Claver |publisher=acb.com |language=es |date=24 August 2015 |access-date=20 July 2016 |archive-date=3 April 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403033322/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115420 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Baskonia obviously was not eager to pay a buy out to Valencia, but the Spanish forward did not want to play in his old team. According to reports, he did not want to play in a team which in the next season was going to compete in the second-tier level [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]], which led to Claver signing with a team outside the Spanish borders.<ref name="Tanteo"/>

===Lokomotiv Kuban (2015–2016)===
On 2 September 2015, the Russian team [[PBC Lokomotiv-Kuban|Lokomotiv Kuban]] announced a one-year deal with Claver for the 2015–16 season.<ref>{{cite news |title=Lokomotiv Kuban announces Victor Claver |url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/174655/lokomotiv-kuban-announces-victor-claver.html |access-date=2 September 2015 |work=sportando.com |date=2 September 2015}}</ref>

===FC Barcelona (2016–2021)===
On 20 July 2016, he signed a three-year deal with [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona Lassa]], after his new team reached an agreement with [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] for acquiring his rights.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.fcbarcelona.com/sections/basketball/first-team/news/2016-2017/victor-claver-signs-with-fc-barcelona-lassa-for-three-seasons |title=Victor Claver signs with FC Barcelona Lassa for three seasons |publisher=fcbarcelona.com |date=20 July 2016 |access-date=20 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.eurohoops.net/featured/284565/barcelona-announced-victor-claver |title=Barcelona announced Victor Claver |publisher=eurohoops.net |date=20 July 2016 |access-date=20 July 2016}}</ref> On 2 July 2019, he extended his contract with FC Barcelona through 2022.<ref>{{cite news |title=Barcelona extends Claver through 2022 |url=https://www.euroleague.net/news/i/9rsxrhjqrjr5jvng |access-date=2 July 2019 |work=EuroLeague.net |date=2 July 2019}}</ref> On 12 July 2021, Claver officially parted ways with the club after five years.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fcbarcelona.com/en/basketball/first-team/news/2187792/victor-claver-to-leave-barca |title=Victor Claver to leave Barça |publisher=fcbarcelona.com/ |date=12 July 2021 |access-date=13 July 2021}}</ref>

===Return to Valencia (2021–2024)===
On 13 July 2021, he signed a three-year deal with [[Valencia Basket|Valencia]] and he plays again for his hometown Valencia.<ref>{{cite web|title=Víctor Claver is back home for his second stage in Valencia Basket|url=https://www.valenciabasket.com/?p=noticias&noticia=7728&lang=en|website=ValenciaBasket.com/|date=13 July 2021|access-date=13 July 2021}}</ref>

On 1 July 2024, Claver announced his retirement from professional basketball.<ref>{{cite web|title=Víctor Claver anuncia su retirada|url=https://www.acb.com/articulo/ver/471449-victor-claver-anuncia-su-retirada.html|website=ACB.com|date=1 July 2024|access-date=1 July 2024|language=Spanish}}</ref>

==National team career==
He was on Spain's junior national teams that won bronze medals at the [[2006 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], and at the [[2008 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]]. He has also played with the [[Spain men's national basketball team]]. Spain's medal cache included: gold medals at the [[EuroBasket 2009]], [[EuroBasket 2011]] and at the [[EuroBasket 2015]], and a bronze medal at the [[EuroBasket 2013]].{{citation needed|date=November 2022}}

He also played at the [[2010 FIBA World Championship]], the [[2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup]], at the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2012 Summer Olympics]], where Spain won a silver medal, and at the [[Basketball at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament|2016 Summer Olympics]], where Spain won a bronze medal.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160304224425/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/victor%20claver/pid//_//players.html Victor CLAVER (ESP) participated in 14 FIBA / FIBA Zones events. ]</ref>
